🏀 MIDNIGHT HOOPZ 🏀
Welcome to Midnight Hoopz — the most competitive basketball experience on Roblox. Build your player, hit the court, and prove you're the best in the game.
⚡ CREATE YOUR BUILD — Customize your player's stats, position, height, weight, and appearance. Every build is unique. Every decision matters.
🏆 COMPETE — Run it back against the best players on the platform. No casuals. Real hoopers only.
🎮 FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT — Plug in and play just like every other Roblox game. Full controller mapping included.
📱 MOBILE FRIENDLY — On-screen controls built for mobile players. Jump in from anywhere.

👑 OWNER: Slizzyy Blizzy
🛠️ DEVELOPERS:
UI: GC3 & ALEX
Lighting/build/MODELER- Tyler (leprechaun)

We're just getting started. Updates dropping constantly. Join the group, follow for notifications, and stay locked in.
